contract: metadata_embed_queue_update emits admin-only {libraryItemId,queued:true} only for an admission that must wait behind a running job. A later dequeue emits {libraryItemId,queued:false} to all users; immediately started work does not fabricate a queued transition (AudioMetadataManager.js).
exceptions: The Go unit test is a discovery lead. Earlier inspection found that immediate Go jobs may emit spurious transitions. Assessment against the shared upstream scenarios awaits the full upstream gate.
The upstream queue tests cover successful immediate, waiting and repeated work. Failure and recovery remain open.
